messages:
Zara Lim: hi team — first day! quick run: how do I get Figma + Notion access, wheres the product roadmap, and where do research recordings live? Also hitting OKTA login loop on signup.

Omar (design-ops): welcome Zara :tada: DM me your work email for Figma. For Notion we use group invites — fill the access form and Ill add you.

Zara Lim: sent DM (zara@redwood.com). FYI the Okta SSO keeps redirecting to a blank page when i try to accept the invite link.

devex-bot: Tip: If youre stuck on SSO, run `/request-access login okta` in #devex and it will open a support ticket for IAM.

Omar (design-ops): hmm, sometimes Okta invites fail if your device blocks third-party cookies. Try incognito or another browser. If that fails, I can invite you as a guest email until IAM fixes the SSO ticket.

Zara Lim: incognito worked for Figma invite, Im in — thanks. Notion still failing via Okta though.

Lena (PM): roadmap is here: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. PMs keep initiative pages editable; designers typically get commenter. If you need edit for the onboarding initiative, tag me.

Raj (UX Research): recordings are on Research Drive; synths + transcripts are in Notion under Research > Artifacts. If Notion invite is blocked, I can DM you direct links to the three most recent onboarding synths.

Zara Lim: please DM the synths, thatd be great. Also Omar — when I opened a file some components were grayed out and the team library said "No seats left". What does that mean?

Omar (design-ops): ah — we hit a Figma license cap this week after a contractor batch. I just freed up 2 seats and re-enabled the "Redwood UI" library for you. If you see missing components, run `Assets > Team Libraries` and toggle the library back on.

Zara Lim: toggled it, components reappeared. thanks! small Q: how do we annotate usability findings in Figma?

Raj (UX Research): we use comments with the prefix "Research:" and the study tag. For persistent notes add a Notion artifact and paste the Notion link in the Figma file comments. Also we have a short template in Research > Templates.

eng-frontend: If you need a local preview to check components, ping #eng-frontend and request a "frontend buddy" pairing. Typical pairing is 30m to get Storybook + local dev running.

Zara Lim: could I shadow a usability session this week? Id like to see note-taking flow.

Raj (UX Research): sure — theres a moderated session Thursday 2pm PT. Ill add you as an observer and share the session prep doc. Also sent you the three synth links via DM.

Lena (PM): tagged you on the onboarding initiative page and gave commenter access. If youd like edit access to add design tasks, say the word and Ill grant it.

Zara Lim: got DM synths and session invite — thanks everyone. One last thing: is there a preferred place for small design questions (quick Qs) — this thread or #design-ops?

Omar (design-ops): quick perms or access Qs — #design-ops. Team chatter/feedback — #product. For anything that needs ticketing, run the devex-bot command in #devex.

Zara Lim: perfect. appreciate the fast help! excited to jump in 60a
